headline: Ghana Warns of Inflationary Pressures from Severe El Niño
summary: Government Statistician Dr Alhassan Iddrisu warned that Ghana could face fresh inflationary pressures from an anticipated severe El Niño weather event. The phenomenon threatens agricultural production, electricity generation, and international supply chains.
why: El Niño weather patterns can severely disrupt agricultural output and energy supply in developing economies, driving up domestic food prices and broader inflation.

impacts.name: Ghana
impacts.why: Disrupted agricultural and energy production can lead to higher inflation rates in the country.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Warnings of weather-related supply chain disruptions and agricultural damage raise concerns over rising consumer prices and inflation.
